pages.title: Animals Jigsaw Puzzle
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Rebuild pictures of animals in Animals Jigsaw Puzzle. Drag the pieces together and follow the outlines and colors to see what fits. Zoom in or check the picture preview when two pieces are hard to tell apart, then see if you can finish another puzzle in less time.

pages.title: Busy Bee Hive
pages.creator: Pavel Beke
pages.description: Build a honey business in Busy Bee Hive. Collect nectar from flowers and process it into honey, then expand into other products as you unlock workstations. Start with a basic extractor and grow the hive enough to open a candle maker or a royal jelly lab.

pages.title: Russian Derby Crash
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Smash cars on a training ground in Russian Derby Crash. Choose from five Russian cars or drive a tank into the arena. Ram other vehicles to wreck them and work toward unlocking more, or use the tank’s gun to fire at other drivers from farther away.

pages.title: Steal Brainrot Arena
pages.creator: CursoraLabs
pages.description: Buy Brainrot characters and try to steal them from rivals in Steal Brainrot Arena. A better collection brings in more money for your next purchase, so decide when to shop and when to attempt a heist. Play alone or bring another player into two-player mode.

pages.title: Geometry Rush
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Jump through passages full of traps in Geometry Rush. Watch where the next obstacle is and time your jumps to get past it. When a run ends, use what you learned about that stretch to make it through on the next attempt and reach a new level.

pages.title: Color Nonogram Puzzle 2
pages.creator: GMG
pages.description: Use number and color clues to uncover pixel art in Color Nonogram Puzzle 2. Check the clues for both the row and column before coloring a square. As more of the picture appears, use the cells you’ve already solved to work out where the remaining colors go.

pages.title: Hide Ball
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Build a shelter for the red ball in Hide Ball. Look at the blocks you’re given and decide where to place them so the spiky enemies can’t reach it. The layouts get trickier as you go, so think through the order before you start putting the cover together.

pages.title: Sudoku Garden
pages.creator: Guangzhou Yomitoo Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Clear blocks according to the rules of each stage in Sudoku Garden. Study the layout for clues about which blocks you can remove and use character abilities when they help you solve a step. Combine those abilities as you work toward unlocking the more advanced puzzles.

pages.title: Space Raider
pages.creator: FatKat Games
pages.description: Drag to steer a spaceship through battles in Space Raider. Keep moving as enemies come into view and line up your attacks while leaving room to dodge. Customize your ship and take it back into the fight as you face more enemies across the galaxy.

pages.title: Kingdom Puzzles
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Place one king in each colored region in Kingdom Puzzles. Kings can’t share rows or columns or touch in neighboring squares, even diagonally. Check where each placement leaves room for the others before committing, because putting a king in the wrong square costs points.

pages.title: sokoban puzzle game
pages.creator: GameBox
pages.description: Push crates onto their targets in sokoban puzzle game. Use the direction buttons to move the pusher and think about where you’ll need to stand for the next push. Get every crate onto its marked spot without trapping one where you can no longer move it.

pages.title: Zombie Chase
pages.creator: Newness Games
pages.description: Move through a grid full of undead in Zombie Chase. Collect resources as you go and set traps where they can slow down pursuing zombies. Look for a way out before entering a tight space, since grabbing supplies can leave you cornered if you forget to plan an escape route.

pages.title: Brain Challenge
pages.creator: FunFarm
pages.description: Work through 250 puzzles in Brain Challenge. Take a close look at what each question asks and at the objects on the screen. Some solutions depend on spotting a detail or trying an interaction you might overlook if you take the prompt at face value.

pages.title: Fantasy Math Number
pages.creator: Cat Summer
pages.description: Fight monsters by solving equations in Fantasy Math Number. Work out addition, subtraction, and multiplication problems to make progress in battle. Keep getting answers right to power up, defeat enemies, and see how high a score you can build on the quest.

pages.title: Battle Arena Race to Win
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Join the Red or Blue team in Battle Arena Race to Win and drive into combat. Pick a car based on its speed, acceleration, and durability, then equip items and upgrade it as you play. Help your side win battles and see how your results compare on the leaderboard.

pages.title: Real Flight Simulator
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Learn to start, steer, and land a plane in Real Flight Simulator. Work through six levels with simplified instruments while you get used to flying. Try different aircraft and check how their power, speed, and braking affect the way they respond.

pages.title: Wood Nuts Master: Screw Puzzle
pages.creator: GameGULF
pages.description: Move screws to free wooden boards in Wood Nuts Master: Screw Puzzle. Check what each screw is holding and decide where you can put it to let a piece fall. The constructions get more complicated as you go, so think about which part needs to come down first.

pages.title: Chain Cube 2048 3D Merge Game
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Launch numbered cubes into the play area in Chain Cube 2048 3D Merge Game. Aim at a cube with the same value to combine them. Unmatched cubes bounce away from each other, so check where they land and look for another shot that can build a bigger number.

pages.title: Jettycat
pages.creator: Ohsat Games
pages.description: Fly a cat through 30 obstacle courses in Jettycat. Use the jetpack to change your height and steer through openings, keeping away from the walls. Watch where the next obstacle is before you boost so you have room to turn in time.

pages.title: Royal Ranch Merge & Collect
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Merge seeds and plants to grow a garden in Royal Ranch Merge & Collect. Start with small plants and work up to flowers, fruits, vegetables, and animals. Check what each quest asks for and use the items you create to fill out your collections.

pages.title: Break Bricks 2 Player
pages.creator: y9-games.com
pages.description: Send a ball into colorful bricks in Break Bricks 2 Player. Clear different formations on your own with three chances, or challenge another player across five rounds. Look for bonuses that add balls or refill health while you work on breaking the remaining cubes.

pages.title: Candy Match 3
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Work through more than 3,000 levels in Candy Match 3. Make groups of matching sweets to clear space, then look for the next combination as the board changes. Take on daily missions and challenges alongside the main puzzles and see what gifts you uncover as you go.

pages.title: Cricket Legends
pages.creator: Gameloft SE
pages.description: Time your batting shots in Cricket Legends. Watch the ball arrive and swing when you have a good chance to connect. Upgrade your players and try their special skills to handle tougher challenges as you work through the cricket matches.

pages.title: Connect Hagi and Kisi
pages.creator: Berezka
pages.description: Rotate the level in Connect Hagi and Kisi to bring Huggy and Kissy together. Watch how the characters move as the layout turns and look for a position that puts them on the same path. Keep adjusting the angle until they touch and complete the puzzle.

pages.title: Noob Miner: Escape from prison
pages.creator: Noob vs Pro team
pages.description: Mine resources while looking for a way out in Noob Miner: Escape from prison. Trade what you dig up for better pickaxes, use cakes and dynamite, and upgrade the mine generator to extract more resources. Explore the map for hidden supplies and look for either of the two escape routes.

pages.title: Maze Game Kids
pages.creator: Rich Games
pages.description: Find your way through 15 mazes in Maze Game Kids. Look ahead for turns that lead to an exit and backtrack when a passage ends. Try to finish each layout quickly, then compare times with friends to see who found the shortest way through.

pages.title: Tricky Puzzle
pages.creator: AppyApp
pages.description: Look for unconventional solutions in Tricky Puzzle. One level asks you to count bees, another has you save aliens or pet a dog. Try interacting with the scene in different ways, and use actions such as tilting or shaking on mobile when the puzzle calls for them.

pages.title: Stickman Warriors
pages.creator: XTStudio
pages.description: Help a framed prisoner find a way out in Stickman Warriors. Guide the stickman through a series of prison escape puzzles and look for what each scene lets you change. Keep working through the obstacles as he tries to get out and clear his name.

pages.title: Drive Bike Stunt Simulator 3d
pages.creator: Driving games
pages.description: Ride a motorcycle through timed stunt missions in Drive Bike Stunt Simulator 3d. Read the instructions for each course and get moving before the clock runs down. Balance speed with control on difficult sections so you can finish the mission and tackle the next one.

pages.title: Star Beacons
pages.creator: Blaster
pages.description: Aim a ball at the stars in Star Beacons. Look for a shot that will bounce through several targets, then adjust your aim for the ones still on the board. Clear all the stars to finish a level or go after every object to work toward the game’s 20 achievements.

pages.title: Monsters.io
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Choose which side to play in Monsters.io. Try to survive among the creatures, or become one and hunt the other side. Each monster has its own abilities and strengths, so switch between them to see how the hunt changes depending on who you control.

pages.title: Year Round Fashionista Curly
pages.creator: Top Girl Games
pages.description: Plan outfits for every month in Year Round Fashionista Curly. Browse clothes that suit the season, from pastels for spring to bright colors for summer and warmer pieces for autumn. Put together a new look as the calendar moves on and the weather changes.

pages.title: Up Color
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Guide your character through colored walls in Up Color. Passing a brick changes your color, so check which section of the next wall matches before you reach it. Move into position quickly enough to keep passing through as the colors change along the route.

pages.title: Wings Rush 2
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Run, jump, and spin through Green Hill, Marble, and Desert zones in Wings Rush 2. Watch for obstacles while picking up rings along the route. Spend those rings to unlock faster characters, then go back through the levels and try to improve your score.

pages.title: Kingdom of Ninja 7
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Dodge monsters and traps in Kingdom of Ninja 7. Time each jump around sharp thorns, rolling balls, and cannon fire as you make your way through the final game in the series. Watch the next hazard before you move, because several threats can block the same route.

pages.title: Merge Monster Pool
pages.creator: Xlab Game Studio
pages.description: Combine matching creatures in Merge Monster Pool to make them grow into different monsters. Look at what you already have before adding another, so you can set up the next match. Keep merging to discover larger creatures and build a higher score.

pages.title: Giant Push!
pages.creator: Bermuda Games
pages.description: Send an army from a cannon in Giant Push! Aim with the joystick and release to launch your minions toward the middle platform. Choose an angle that puts more of your team where they can push, then see if they can force the platform past the opposing side.

pages.title: fill one line puzzle game
pages.creator: ZKgame
pages.description: Trace a single path through every block in fill one line puzzle game. Look at where each turn will leave you before you fill in the next space. If you keep getting stuck with part of the board untouched, use a hint to help find a route.

pages.title: Drift Torque
pages.creator: Fuego! Games
pages.description: Take one of ten cars out on five tracks in Drift Torque. Build up speed as you approach a turn, then steer into a slide and keep it under control through the bend. Try different cars and courses to see where you can hold a drift longer.

pages.title: Arkadium's Mahjongg Dimensions 900 seconds
pages.creator: Arkadium
pages.description: Rotate a block of tiles to find matching pairs in Arkadium's Mahjongg Dimensions 900 seconds. Look for pieces you can select along the edges, then turn the structure to check another side. Use the 900-second clock to see how many layers you can clear.

pages.title: Princess After Back Surgery
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Help Princess Mia recover after a back injury in Princess After Back Surgery. Follow the treatment steps to take care of her wounds. Once she’s ready for a change of clothes, look through the costumes and pick something for her to wear after the procedure.

pages.title: Tractors Hidden Tires
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Find ten hidden tires in each picture in Tractors Hidden Tires. The first scene gives you 80 seconds, with five seconds less for every new level. Search the tractor scenes carefully and finish each one in time to unlock the next of the six pictures.

pages.title: Fruitlinker
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Connect identical fruit tiles in Fruitlinker before the timer runs out. A link can make up to two turns, so look for an open route around the other tiles before selecting a pair. Clear the easier pairs first when they’re blocking a path to the rest of the fruit.

pages.title: Shape of Water
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Use geometric pieces to guide water into a container in Shape of Water. Make a route that keeps the stream from spilling, then identify the shape you’ve filled to move on. Too much water outside the container means a restart, so watch how the flow changes across all nine puzzles.

pages.title: Snowball War: Space Shooter
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Pilot a ship through a snowball storm in Snowball War: Space Shooter. Move away from the falling snowballs and shoot them as you find an opening. Keep the ship clear of the next wave as you try to make it home for Christmas.

pages.title: Christmas Jigsaw Challenge
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Reassemble holiday scenes in Christmas Jigsaw Challenge. Look for colors and outlines that continue from one piece to the next, then work your way across the picture. Choose a harder setting when you want to try putting the same kind of scene together with more of a challenge.

pages.title: TrollFace Quest: Horror 3
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Click around unsettling scenes in TrollFace Quest: Horror 3. Try the details that look out of place and see what reaction they set off. Each puzzle has one solution, so look for an unexpected interaction if the first thing you try leads to a scare.

pages.title: Uppercase Lowercase
pages.creator: nau.games
pages.description: Practice matching capital and lowercase letters in Uppercase Lowercase. Look at the letter the game shows you and click its corresponding form. Pay attention to letters that change shape when capitalized, and use what you remember to make the next match.

pages.title: Police Car Stunt Simulation 3D
pages.creator: Best Free Games
pages.description: Drive police cars through stunt courses in Police Car Stunt Simulation 3D. Use ramps for jumps, explore the city, and hit objects to see what breaks. Keep an eye on the fuel as you drive, since it limits how long you can stay out on a run.

pages.title: Boat Coordinates
pages.creator: MathNook
pages.description: Set x and y coordinates to guide a boat in Boat Coordinates. Adjust the values with the arrows and press Move to send it to that spot. Collect all the buoys and avoid land or passing boats on the way to the finish across ten levels.

pages.title: Impossible Cars Punk Stunt
pages.creator: Playnec
pages.description: Choose from 11 cars in Impossible Cars Punk Stunt. Race against the clock on 22 courses in Career Mode, or take your car into the open driving area in Free Mode. Work on controlling the car as you take it across stunt tracks and around tight turns.

pages.title: Tom Runner
pages.creator: pyxel and soft
pages.description: Help Tom keep moving in Tom Runner. Watch the route for obstacles and jump in time to get past them. Look ahead as soon as you land so you’re ready to clear the next hazard and see how far Tom can go.

pages.title: Coronavirus Crush
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Match three or more identical viruses in Coronavirus Crush. Make larger groups when you can to earn more points and reach the level’s target. The timer keeps running while you look for matches, so keep an eye on both the board and the points you still need.

pages.title: Virus War Multiplayer
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Steer a virus around the arena in Virus War Multiplayer. Aim at the other viruses and shoot while moving to avoid their attacks. Pick a virus before entering the match and look for a position that gives you a clear shot when an opponent comes into range.

pages.title: Block Craft Jigsaw Puzzle
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Rebuild block-themed scenes in Block Craft Jigsaw Puzzle. Look for colors and edges that carry across neighboring pieces, then move each piece to where it belongs. Start with the shapes you recognize and build around them until the picture is complete.

pages.title: Pixel Gun Spin Wheel Earn Gems&Coins
pages.creator: yaine
pages.description: Give the wheel a spin in Pixel Gun Spin Wheel Earn Gems&Coins. Watch which space it lands on and see what the result gives you. Guess the number before the spin if you want to test your luck, then try again to see whether the next result brings gems or coins.

pages.title: Cartoon Police Cars Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Put together six cartoon police car pictures in Cartoon Police Cars Puzzle. Choose a layout of 16, 36, 64, or 100 pieces for each scene. Match up the shapes and colors of the cars and their backgrounds as you restore each picture.

pages.title: Monster Truck Driver
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Pick a truck and explore three driving environments in Monster Truck Driver. Try the different vehicles and use the maps to practice stunts. Get used to how a truck handles over the terrain, then take another one out and see how it responds on the same course.

pages.title: Roll Out
pages.creator: Hihoy
pages.description: Steer a fast-moving ball in Roll Out. Keep it away from red and purple sections as the route unfolds, because touching either color ends the run. Look ahead for a safe line and make your next move before the ball reaches the hazard.

pages.title: Pink bird recuse
pages.creator: games2mad
pages.description: Find a way to open a cage in Pink bird recuse. Search the scene for objects and clues that can help a mother bird free her hungry chick. Click what you find and work through the puzzles until you can get the chick out.

pages.title: Fish Eat Fish
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Guide a piranha toward smaller fish in Fish Eat Fish. Every fish you eat helps you grow, while larger fish can swallow you if you get too close. Keep looking for targets you can handle and compete for space in a game designed for three players.

pages.title: Sweet Cotton Candy Maker
pages.creator: TrendyGames
pages.description: Run a candy shop in Sweet Cotton Candy Maker. Follow the instructions to turn colored sugar into cotton candy. Choose the colors for your batch, then work through the steps and see how the strands come together before you try making another one.

pages.title: Police Driver
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Take a police car out for a drive in Police Driver. Choose from several vehicles and try them in different environments. Get used to steering a car through the area you’ve picked, then switch to another car or location for a different drive.

pages.title: Uber Sim Transport 2020
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Pick up passengers and drive them to their destinations in Uber Sim Transport 2020. Work through the career mode and get to the people waiting for a ride. Keep the car under control as you follow the route and finish each trip before taking the next fare.

pages.title: Offroad Kings Hill Climb Driving
pages.creator: Smartline-Games
pages.description: Drive over hills, through rivers, and across bridges in Offroad Kings Hill Climb Driving. Adjust your speed as the terrain changes and see whether you can make it to the finish. Earn money along the way and use it to try a different vehicle on another run.

pages.title: Dolce Instagram Fashionista
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Style Dolce for her followers in Dolce Instagram Fashionista. Use her as a model while you try different clothes and beauty choices. Put together the outfit you want her to share, then see how changing the details gives the finished look a different style.

pages.title: Happy Cub
pages.creator: Good Funny Game
pages.description: Guide water into the glass in Happy Cub. Look at where the stream starts and decide how to give it a path to the cup. Adjust your route around the layout so the water reaches its destination and fills the glass.

pages.title: Geometry Rash Challenge
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Get past obstacles and reach the finish in Geometry Rash Challenge. Pick up stars as you go, but watch where you’ll need to move next before going after one. Spend the stars you’ve earned on new characters and take another run through the course.

pages.title: Hungry Line Physics
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Draw a line to guide a hungry face toward a doughnut in Hungry Line Physics. Think about how the shape of your line will affect where it rolls. Adjust the route when it misses, and work through the later puzzles as the layouts get more complicated.

pages.title: Santa Shadow Match
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Pick the shadow that matches the figure in Santa Shadow Match. Check the outline closely before selecting an answer, because a correct match earns 500 points and a wrong choice costs 100. Use details in the figure’s shape to tell similar silhouettes apart.

pages.title: Fruit Juice Maker
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Blend drinks for customers in Fruit Juice Maker. Check what they order, select the ingredients, and use the blender to prepare the juice. Keep an eye on how long each customer has been waiting as you serve the drinks, and try the other modes for a different set of tasks.

pages.title: Merge & Hit Knives
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Combine identical knives in Merge & Hit Knives to unlock stronger weapons, including daggers and swords. Keep merging to expand the collection, then switch to the throwing challenges to put your weapons to use. Work through the levels as you build up experience.

pages.title: Vincy Cooking Red Velvet Cake
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Help Vincy bake a red velvet cake in Vincy Cooking Red Velvet Cake. Work through the preparation steps before decorating the finished cake. Choose how you want the top to look and put the finishing touches in place once the baking is done.

pages.title: Halloween Matching
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Clear groups of matching Halloween faces in Halloween Matching before the timer runs out. Match four in a line to make a bomb, or match five for a piece that clears every face of the same type. Look for larger matches to earn extra time and keep the board moving.

pages.title: Happy Snowman Coloring
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Choose from eight snowman pictures in Happy Snowman Coloring. Use the 23-color palette to fill in the scenes, and work quickly if you want to go for a higher score. Save your picture when it looks the way you want, then try a different snowman.

pages.title: Off Track Jungle Race
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Race through rough terrain in Off Track Jungle Race. Steer through bumps and turns as you try to beat your rivals in time attack. Watch the route ahead and keep the vehicle moving toward the finish while the course takes you off the paved roads.

pages.title: Kikker Connect
pages.creator: WPG Kindermedia
pages.description: Connect matching illustrations in Kikker Connect. The path between two tiles can make up to two turns and has to stay clear of other tiles. Remove pairs to open more routes, and collect butterflies to unlock new pictures of Kikker and his friends.

pages.title: Table Tennis Pro
pages.creator: GameBiz
pages.description: Play table tennis against the computer or a friend in Table Tennis Pro. Move your paddle to return the ball, then vary your shots with smashes and spin. Try Career Mode to see how far you can advance as you get more comfortable with the timing.

pages.title: Clean Word
pages.creator: marcos bart games
pages.description: Clear falling litter before it reaches the ground in Clean Word. Watch where each piece appears and tap it while it’s still in the air. Keep looking for the next item as you build your score and try to beat your previous run.

pages.title: One Line
pages.creator: 4j.com
pages.description: Draw the entire pattern in a single stroke in One Line. Pick a starting point and think through the turns before you begin. If your route keeps leaving part of the drawing unfinished, try approaching it from another end or use a hint.

pages.title: Happy Glass Puzzles
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Try three water and glass challenges in Happy Glass Puzzles. Remove blocks without spilling, fill a glass to the target, or flip it so it lands in the right spot. Work through the levels in each mode and judge how the glass and water will move before you act.

pages.title: Halloween Bingo
pages.creator: Freak X Games
pages.description: Spin the wheel to call out numbers in Halloween Bingo. Mark a number when it appears on your card and watch how close you are to finishing. Keep taking turns with the wheel as you try to complete your bingo before the computer does.

pages.title: Squary Bird
pages.creator: Dreamly Games
pages.description: Keep a square bird airborne in Squary Bird. Time your flaps to go through the gaps without hitting what’s above or below you. Choose from three birds and see how far you can take one through the day and night scenery.

pages.title: Home Difference
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Find five differences between two pictures in Home Difference. Compare the scenes and click details that change from one image to the other. Finish the current search to unlock another level and start looking for differences in a new pair of pictures.

pages.title: Mermaid flies to Tokyo
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Get Ariel ready for a trip to Tokyo in Mermaid flies to Tokyo. Start with her suitcase and decorate it so she can spot it easily. Work through the other travel preparations as she gets ready to explore the city and its fashions.

pages.title: Princess Teen Lingerie Boutique
pages.creator: MyCuteGames
pages.description: Pick sleepwear for a royal slumber party in Princess Teen Lingerie Boutique. Browse the shop for outfits and add dressing gowns, slippers, or cozy socks. Give the guests their own combinations, then see how the looks come together at the party.

pages.title: Annie Perfect Night
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Get Annie ready for a castle party in Annie Perfect Night. Choose her makeup and look through the dresses for the celebration she and Kristof are hosting. Try different combinations and settle on the look you want her to wear when the guests arrive.

pages.title: Kick Trick
pages.creator: Kizi
pages.description: Keep a soccer ball in the air in Kick Trick. Time your moves to juggle with your feet, knees, or head as the ball drops. Watch its height after every touch and keep the streak going to see how high you can push your score.

pages.title: Silly Ways to Die: Adventures 2
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Help accident-prone creatures stay safe in Silly Ways to Die: Adventures 2. Watch what happens in each scene and react before a character gets hurt. The danger changes from one situation to the next, so check what’s about to go wrong before you act.

pages.title: Samantha Plum: The Globetrotting Chef
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Search for hidden objects at food destinations in Samantha Plum: The Globetrotting Chef. Help Samantha find inspiration for the opening of her restaurant, The Loving Table. Look through each scene for the items she needs and use hints if a detail is hard to spot.

pages.title: Magic Stones 2
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Tap groups of two or more stones of the same color in Magic Stones 2. Clear the groups that help you reach each level’s target, then use what’s left to plan another match. Completing levels earns experience and unlocks special powers for later puzzles.

pages.title: X Trial Racing
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Ride a motorcycle through rough terrain in X Trial Racing. Balance the bike over the obstacles and adjust your speed before slopes and drops. Make it through without crashing to finish the ride and keep your chances of taking the title alive.
